name: – Konstantinos Arvanitis – Recital R – Am 14
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: R. whereas corruption remains a major concern for EU citizens, as shown by the 2025 Eurobarometer survey on corruption54 ; whereas in particular, 69 % of those surveyed consider corruption to be widespread in their country and 51 % believe it is widespread within political parties; whereas the survey respondents overwhelmingly reject corrupt practices, with 71 % of them considering that it is never acceptable to do favours in exchange for advantages from public authorities, 74 % rejecting the giving of gifts and 80 % rejecting the giving of money to obtain such advantages; whereas 5 % of the people surveyed report having experienced or witnessed corruption in the past 12 months but only one in five reported it, and less than half of the respondents know where to report a case of corruption; whereas the Commission, in its Eurobarometer surveys, previously assessed public perceptions of corruption within the EU institutions, but has discontinued the publication of such data despite numerous serious scandals; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 54 European Commission, ‘Special Eurobarometer 561: Citizens’ attitudes towards corruption in the EU in 2025’, July 2025.
